title: SECOND LEVEL SPELLS - the 20 second level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R660 OA second level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round forty-seven (capture pp. 119-126): the second level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: SECOND LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 119-126 - the OA second level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 20 second level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 119-125; compressed pp. 60-63); all 20 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. Two reads worth the note: detect charm's components read V, S in both passes (the print line breaking at its page boundary, the compressed confirming), and dream sight takes the somatic and material components only - the level's unique no-verbal spell. The abjuration school debuts this level (protection from spirits, request), and aid's dual school necromantic/conjuration pins as the primary necromantic. Request takes the longest cast in the level at three turns. The reversible flags agree between the passes; the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid, settled two rounds before. The stat grid pins as a table: 20 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, 3 turns = 180), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag L2Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 113 closed, 122 open - the Second Level Spells box flips (census 582 -> 583); NEXT - R661: the Third Level Spells (capture pp. 126-132), prefix dhv (verify free), audit "R661 OA third level spells audit", include after rules/oal2spells.h
